notes: Cats: one category of each bank carries the whole subject, Bordeaux in the Régionale bank (63 stems) and Bordeaux in the Village bank (54); the Sauternes stems that sit under Dessert & Sweet Wines, Sparkling/Fortified/Sweet and Sweet Wines are left out because those categories carry Tokaji, Port and Bergerac as well. Chapters: the Régionale chapter bordeaux and the Village chapter Bordeaux. Regions: the bordeaux article alone, which holds the Court's appellations, the 1855 estates and the Right Bank producers in its places and producers. Country: france for the three tiers of French law and the cru card. Grapes: the eight the Court names that the Codex profiles; Muscadelle has no profile. Techniques: noble rot for Sauternes, assemblage for the blend the Court puts in every cell, oak for the new French barrique. Service tables: decanting (two rows name young and mature Bordeaux) and temperatures, the Court's Certified service cell.
